notes: UT Dallas's completeness count from the 2026 edition's program list (catalog.utdallas.edu/2026/undergraduate/programs; the edition home prints '2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog'), recounted 2026-10-21 under programs/catalog_counts.py: most degrees are printed twice ('Bachelor of Science in X (120 semester credit hours)' and 'X (BS)'), which is one program; credit hours are not part of a name; '(Double Major)' entries combine two majors and are not counted; 'BA in X - Y' (a concentration or certification focus) is an option of 'Bachelor of Arts in X' where that degree is listed, so the five BA Education focus records do not count separately (the two BS Education focuses have no plain 'BS in Education' line and count as listed).

67 current candidates re-identify a verified bachelor's record on file (same program key, same name on the same program page, or the one verified record on that page) and are counted; 64 verified bachelor's records on file. This decision promotes nothing.
